To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

carbon nanotube/polar polymer nanocomposites are a promising new class of nanocomposite materials that exhibit a wide range of interesting properties that are dependent on the size, shape, and dispersion state of the carbon nanotubes.

carbon nanotubes are excellent reinforcing fillers in polymers, that the properties of nanotube/polar polymer composites are very dependent on the dispersion state of nanotubes, and that there are several challenges that need to be overcome before nanotube/polymers are commercially viable.

the mechanical, electrical, thermal, rheological, and flammablity properties of polymer nanocomposite materials containing carbon nanotubes depend on the size and aspect ratio of the nanotube, their dispersion state and loading, the alignment of the nanotubles, the fabrication method, the polymer matrix, and the nanotube surface chemistry.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new nanoscale materials with novel properties.
the preparation, characterization, and properties of polymer nanocomposite materials in which the nanofiller is a single-wall carbon nanotube (SWCNT).
the synthesis and properties of polymer nanocomposite materials containing carbon nanotubes as the filler.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the field of carbon nanotube polymer nanocomposites has made significant progress in the past few years, but there are many challenges ahead.
the field of nanocomposites containing single-wall carbon nanotubes is still in its infancy, with a great potential for future development.
polymer nanocomposites containing carbon nanotubes have great potential to revolutionize the materials world.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can make nanocomposites with a variety of polymer matrices, that we can make them in a variety of ways and that they exhibit a variety of properties.
the properties of polymer nanocomposite materials containing carbon nanotubes are highly dependent on the dispersion of the nanotube filler.
the dispersion of nanotubes is a major issue that must be addressed before their full potential can be realized.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dispersion state of nanotubes is critical to the performance of nanocomposites.
the properties of polymer nanotube composites are highly dependent on the processing conditions, the nature of the polymer matrix, and the dispersion state of carbon nanotube fillers.
polymer nanocomposites with carbon nanotube fillers are a promising class of materials with unique and potentially useful physical properties.
